title: スタンド付き小型版画プレス
description: 美術室・地域工房に置く手回し版画プレス。上下二本の太いローラーと両側フレーム、上部の調整ねじ・Tハンドル、長い送り盤と無地マット、支持ローラー、三本スポークの手回し輪とグリップ、補強した四脚スタンドを造形。紙・版・インク・作品は含みません。ローラー・送り盤・調整機構は静止し、印刷や圧力性能の検証はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.570 × 1.409 × 1.111 m、12,320三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A hand-cranked printmaking press for art rooms and community workshops. It has two thick pressure rollers with side frames, upper adjustment screws/T handles, long sliding bed and plain mat, support idlers, a three-spoke feed handwheel with crank grip, and a braced four-leg stand. Paper, plates, ink and artworks are absent. Rollers, bed and adjustments are fixed; printing and pressure performance are not validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.570 × 1.409 × 1.111 m; 12,320 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
